usage.callShape: POST https://stabletravel.dev/api/transfers/search with JSON body {startLocationCode, endAddressLine, endCityName, endCountryCode, transferType, startDateTime, passengers}
quirks: endGeoCode ALONE is NOT enough — it returns 200 but Amadeus error 32803 'MISSING DROP OFF LOCATION INFORMATION'. You MUST send the full drop-off address: endAddressLine + endCityName + endCountryCode (sending endGeoCode too is fine but optional).
startLocationCode must be a valid IATA airport code (e.g. CDG).
Each search costs ~$0.003 even when it returns the validation error (you pay for the failed-input call), so build the body correctly the first time.
Response is large (~280KB) — body.data[] holds many offers; read price from .data[i].converted.monetaryAmount.
This is the SEARCH endpoint only. The sibling /book and /cancel endpoints are real irreversible money-movers — do not call without explicit user approval.
usage.guide: Search Amadeus airport transfers via POST https://stabletravel.dev/api/transfers/search (x402, ~$0.003/call, no API key). Body must include startLocationCode (IATA airport, e.g. CDG), the full drop-off address (endAddressLine + endCityName + endCountryCode — endGeoCode alone is rejected with 'MISSING DROP OFF LOCATION INFORMATION'), transferType (e.g. PRIVATE), startDateTime (ISO local), and passengers. Read offers from body.data[]: each has a price at .converted.monetaryAmount/.currencyCode, vehicle at .vehicle.description, and provider at .serviceProvider.name. Booking/cancelling is a separate endpoint and is irreversible — confirm with the user first.
